inTheSaucer.say: Grey: Oh no. The human is awake! We grabbed the wrong human.
Other grey: Too late now. It gets the book. Put it back to sleep!
Narrator: Some time later. You are home, in the pines. Mostly in one piece.

inThePines.say: Grey: Hey. Wake up, human. Listen. This is the Book. It is yours now.
Other grey: Your woods are full of cryptids. Big ones, hairy ones. They are real, and something is waking them up.
Grey: The Book wants every one of them. You catch them, the Book holds them. Do what it says.
Other grey: Or the thing waking them up wakes all the way up. Bad, bad, BAD. We never say bad three times.
Voice from the saucer: Get in! IT is waking up. Go, go, go!
Narrator: You wake alone in the pines. The Book is on your chest. It is warm.
Book: Open me. I will explain. Slowly.
